gizlilik.1: The photo is sent to the Google Cloud Vision service only to read the text on it. This app does not store the photo. The text that is read is stored only on this device so that you can compare products (the last 20 scans and the products you save); it is not sent to us. Processing on Google's side is subject to Google's own terms.
gizlilik.2: Photograph only the ingredients section of the pack. Make sure no personal information such as a face, name, address or document is in the frame.
gizlilik.3: Your profile choices (allergens, vegan etc.) are stored only on this device and are not sent to us.
gizlilik.4: The app does not require an account and uses no advertising or tracking tools. When you share a result, only the daily share count goes up by one; no product, text or personal information is sent.
gizlilik.5: When you scan a barcode, the number is sent to our server to find the product; the server asks Open Food Facts on its own behalf, so your IP address is not passed on or stored. Ingredients you read from a photo are saved with the barcode only if you allow it (without the photo, location or personal information). With your contributions goes a contributor number generated at random on this device at your first contribution; it is not derived from your name, device or IP address and only serves to count your contributions together. The My badges and Products I added screens use this number to ask the server only for the status of the products you added. When no ingredients are found for a barcode, its number and product type are counted once from this device for the list of wanted products (without your IP address or contributor number).

ulke.tr.izin_dogrulanmadi: The authorisation status in Türkiye has not been verified yet.
ulke.tr.koz_uyum: In Türkiye, the Cosmetic Products Regulation is aligned with these annexes up to the end of 2023; the Türkiye status of later EU amendments is shown on the cards.
ulke.tr.liste.alt: Records of food imitation and adulteration published by the Turkish Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry. Product, company and place names are shown in Turkish, as published; product groups and findings are translated.
ulke.tr.liste.alt_not: Source: guvenilirgida.tarimorman.gov.tr. Information is shown exactly as announced by the Ministry; this app adds no comment. Records removed from the Ministry's list continue to be shown with the label “Removed from list”. This is not an official app and has no connection with the Turkish Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry.

besin.sorun.doymus_yag: saturates are higher than total fat
besin.sorun.toplam: the lines add up to more than 100 g
besin.sorun.kj_kcal: energy may have been written in kJ

besin.sorun.cok_satir: the same line was read twice with different values
besin.birim_sor: Are the values per 100 g or per 100 ml? Drinks have different thresholds, so no colours are shown until you choose.
besin.kaynak_etiket: Source: the table in the label text that was read.
besin.kaynak_off: Source: Open Food Facts (last updated: {tarih}). The table on the pack may differ.
besin.kaynak_off_tarihsiz: Source: Open Food Facts. The table on the pack may differ.
besin.kaynak_elle: You entered or confirmed these values ({tarih}).
besin.esik_kaynak: UK Department of Health, front of pack nutrition labelling guidance (2016), Annex 3
besin.hukum_not: The low threshold is the “low” nutrition claim threshold in Regulation (EC) No 1924/2006. A colour only describes the amount on that line; it is not a verdict on the product as a whole.
besin.porsiyon_not: The portion criterion in the guidance (for portions over 100 g) was not applied; the portion size is not known.
besin.enerji_not: Energy is not colour-coded (as in the guidance).
besin.form.not: Enter the per 100 g column (per 100 ml for drinks) from the table on the product. A line left empty counts as not read; you can write “<0.5”. The values are stored only on this device.
besin.form.geri: Back to the values that were read

ekle.alt: Products you added by barcode and their status
ekle.not: A product you add by barcode is verified when someone else adds the same ingredients at least 10 minutes later. Only verified products count towards badges. The list is fetched from the server with this device's contributor number.
ekle.bos: You have not added any products by barcode yet. When you scan the label of a barcode that is not in the database, you are offered to add it.

topluluk.hedef_tamam: We reached the goal of {h} verified products. Thank you!
topluluk.hedef_not: A product is verified when two different people add the same ingredients at least 10 minutes apart. The numbers are everyone's additions combined; there is no personal ranking.
topluluk.eksik_not: Products whose barcode people scanned but whose ingredients could not be found; most wanted first. If you have the product, you can add it by taking a photo of the ingredients.
topluluk.eksik_bos: There are no wanted products of this type without ingredients right now.
topluluk.gizlilik: This list contains no personal information: only the barcode number, the product type and how many times it was searched. The product name is added on your device from the Open Food Facts data in the app.
